A '''fusion coil''' was a technological component used aboard [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. While serving aboard a Star Destroyer as maintenance techs, [[Hass Sonax]] and her sister, [[Resh (Sluissi)|Resh]], were present when a faulty fusion coil exploded and caused a thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] mission delay. As punishment, the vessel's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] executed Resh.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
